nodes.name: EVERY DAY AT 7:00AM BST OR 2:00PM PHT
READ CAMPAIGNS ALREADY LOGGED
nodes.notes:
Duplicate guard: campaign_id values already in the sheet are skipped downstream. 

alwaysOutputData keeps the run alive on an empty sheet (first run); only the extract node reads this, and it tolerates the empty item.

nodes.name: RETRIEVE CAMPAIGN LISTING PAGES
nodes.notes:
Follows the "Go to next page" link until it disappears (the last page has none). 

Logged out, jestr.gg shows only 2 pages; ?page=3+ just repeats page 2, so a page-number loop would never end. 

Capped at 25 pages.

nodes.name: EXTRACT NEW CAMPAIGNS FROM LISTING
nodes.notes:
Parses the Next.js page data (not the visible HTML, which truncates tags to 3 + "+N"), de-duplicates across pages, and drops campaign IDs already in the sheet. 

Throws if a run finds zero campaigns, which means the site layout changed.

nodes.name: RETRIEVE CAMPAIGN DETAIL PAGE
nodes.notes: One request per NEW campaign only, 1 per second. A page that still fails after retries is skipped, not written, so tomorrow's run picks it up again.

nodes.name: BUILD SHEET ROWS
nodes.notes:
Merges each listing card with its detail page (dates, studio, links). 

Rows whose detail data could not be read keep the listing fields and get details_found = no. 

Throws only if no detail page parses at all (site layout changed).

nodes.name: SKIP CAMPAIGN UNTIL NEXT RUN
nodes.notes: Detail page failed after 3 tries. Nothing is written for this campaign, so it is still "new" tomorrow and gets retried then. Check this node's input in the execution log to see which ones were skipped.

parameters.content:
## Jestr Campaigns Monitoring

**Purpose:**
- Scraped https://www.jestr.gg/campaigns and the details of each campaign.

## Documentation
- Runs every day at 7:00AM BST OR 2:00PM PHT

- Reads the campaign_ids already in AI Automation: Jestr Campaigns Monitoring (Campaigns List tab)

- Fetches the listing pages on jestr.gg/campaigns. It follows the next page link until there's isn't one, with a cap of 25 pages and 1 second between requests.

- Pull each campaign's data from the page's embedded data rather than the visible text, because the visible cards only show 3 tags plus +N. it skipps any campaign already in the sheet.

- Opens each new campaign's page for extra details, one per second.

- Adds one row per new campaign. Existing rows are never edited.
